<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/university-enrollment">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_UniversityEnrollment" name="University enrollment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Application" name="Begin application"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit application online"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ApplicationParallelSplit" name="Run application work concurrently"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessFees" name="Process application fees or waivers"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FeesProcessed" name="Fees or waivers processed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewApplication" name="Review application and supporting documents"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocumentsComplete" name="Are all documents received?" default="Flow_DocumentsMissing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyMissingDocuments" name="Notify applicant of missing documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideMissingDocuments" name="Provide missing documents"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EvaluateApplication" name="Evaluate application by admissions committee"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApplicationDecision" name="Is the application accepted?" default="Flow_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendAcceptanceLetter" name="Send acceptance letter"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" name="Confirm enrollment by the deadline"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_EnrollmentDeadline" name="Enrollment deadline expires" attachedToRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDate>specified enrollment deadline</bpmn:timeDate>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ApplicationCanceled" name="Application canceled"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostConfirmationSplit" name="Provide materials and prepare services"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveOrientationMaterials" name="Receive orientation materials"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SetUpStudentAccounts" name="Set up student accounts for email, online portals, and library access"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalStudent" name="Is the student international?" default="Flow_NotInternational"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssistVisaProcessing" name="Assist with visa processing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternationalMerge" name="Continue after international student check"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PostConfirmationJoin" name="Preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ObtainStudentID" name="Obtain student ID card"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAdvisor" name="Meet with an academic advisor"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCourses" name="Select courses"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ResolveScheduleConflicts" name="Resolve schedule conflicts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AttendClasses" name="Attend classes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddDropCourses" name="Add or drop courses during the add/drop period"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PostGrades" name="Post grades"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewGrades" name="Review grades online"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Grievance" name="Does the student have a grievance?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitAppeal" name="Submit appeal form"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" name="Meet with the appeals committee"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" name="Await appeal decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AppealMerge" name="Continue after appeal decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StudentStatus" name="Graduate, withdraw, or continue?"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Graduated" name="Student graduates"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Withdrawn" name="Student withdraws"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Rejection letter sent; application ends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSubmit" sourceRef="StartEvent_Application" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitToParallel" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelToFees" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ProcessFees"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FeesToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ProcessFees" targetRef="EndEvent_FeesProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelToReview" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToDocuments" sourceRef="Task_ReviewApplication" targetRef="Gateway_DocumentsComplete"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsMissing" name="Documents missing" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsComplete" targetRef="Task_NotifyMissingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotifyToProvide" sourceRef="Task_NotifyMissingDocuments" targetRef="Task_ProvideMissingDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProvideToReview" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMissingDocuments" targetRef="Task_ReviewApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DocumentsComplete" name="All documents received" sourceRef="Gateway_DocumentsComplete" targetRef="Task_EvaluateApplication">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${allDocumentsReceived}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EvaluateToDecision" sourceRef="Task_EvaluateApplication" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicationDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted" name="Accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationDecision" targetRef="Task_SendAcceptanceLetter">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${applicationAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rejected" name="Not accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicationDecision" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptanceToConfirm" sourceRef="Task_SendAcceptanceLetter" targetRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmToPreparation" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmEnrollment" targetRef="Gateway_PostConfirmationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeadlineToCanceled" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_EnrollmentDeadline" targetRef="EndEvent_ApplicationCanceled"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationToOrientation" sourceRef="Gateway_PostConfirmationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrientationMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrientationToJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrientationMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_PostConfirmationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationToAccounts" sourceRef="Gateway_PostConfirmationSplit" targetRef="Task_SetUpStudentAccounts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountsToInternational" sourceRef="Task_SetUpStudentAccounts" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalStudent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InternationalYes" name="International student" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalStudent" targetRef="Task_AssistVisaProcessing">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${studentIsInternational}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InternationalToMerge" sourceRef="Task_AssistVisaProcessing" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInternational" name="Not international" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalStudent" targetRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InternationalMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_InternationalMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PostConfirmationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToStudentID" sourceRef="Gateway_PostConfirmationJoin" targetRef="Task_ObtainStudentID"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StudentIDToAdvisor" sourceRef="Task_ObtainStudentID" targetRef="Task_MeetAdvisor"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdvisorToCourses" sourceRef="Task_MeetAdvisor" targetRef="Task_SelectCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CoursesToConflicts" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourses" targetRef="Task_ResolveScheduleConflicts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConflictsToClasses" sourceRef="Task_ResolveScheduleConflicts" targetRef="Task_AttendClasses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ClassesToAddDrop" sourceRef="Task_AttendClasses" targetRef="Task_AddDropCourses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddDropToGrades" sourceRef="Task_AddDropCourses" targetRef="Task_PostGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GradesToReview" sourceRef="Task_PostGrades" targetRef="Task_ReviewGrades"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReviewToGrievance" sourceRef="Task_ReviewGrades" targetRef="Gateway_Grievance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GrievanceYes" name="Grievance" sourceRef="Gateway_Grievance" targetRef="Task_SubmitAppeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitAppealToMeeting" sourceRef="Task_SubmitAppeal" targetRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MeetingToAwait" sourceRef="Task_MeetAppealsCommittee" targetRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AwaitToAppealMerge" sourceRef="Task_AwaitAppealDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AppealMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoGrievance" name="No grievance" sourceRef="Gateway_Grievance" targetRef="Gateway_AppealMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppealMergeToStatus" sourceRef="Gateway_AppealMerge" targetRef="Gateway_StudentStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusToGraduate" name="Graduate" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_Graduated"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusToWithdraw" name="Withdraw" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentStatus" targetRef="EndEvent_Withdrawn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusToNextSemester" name="Continue next semester" sourceRef="Gateway_StudentStatus" targetRef="Task_AttendClasses"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
